title: Protocol for generating human induced neural progenitor cells from immobilized adult peripheral blood
protocol: Collect 8 mL peripheral blood from each donor into sodium heparin blood collection tubes by venipuncture.
Transfer the collected blood from each donor into a 15 mL sterile conical tube.
Add equal volume of DPBS to dilute the peripheral blood gently.
Add 4 mL Ficoll-Paque Premium in a 15 mL sterile conical tube.
Carefully load half volume of diluted blood samples onto the top of the Ficoll layer using a 10 mL pipette.
Repeat loading for the other half of the diluted blood samples into another 15 mL sterile conical tube.
Centrifuge the tubes at 400 × g for 30 min at 25°C in a swinging bucket rotor.
Remove the upper plasma layer by aspiration, leaving a small volume on top of the opaque interface containing the MNC layer.
Collect the MNCs carefully and transfer them from two 15 mL tubes into a 50 mL conical tube.
Add DPBS to a final volume of 50 mL and centrifuge at 450 × g for 15 min at 25°C.
Discard the supernatant after setting the centrifuge brake to “on.”
Resuspend the pellets with 5 mL red cell lysis buffer and incubate at 25°C for 10 min.
Add DPBS to a final volume of 50 mL and centrifuge at 450 × g for 10 min at 25°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellets with 30 mL DPBS.
Centrifuge at 450 × g for 10 min at 25°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells with 5 mL DPBS.
Aliquot 10 μL of cell suspension, mix with 10 μL of 0.4% trypan blue solution.
Count the viable cells using a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge the rest of the cell suspension at 450 × g for 5 min at 25°C.
Resuspend the pellets with appropriate volume of MNC medium to a density of ~3 × 10^6 cells/mL for expanding MNCs.
Alternatively, remove the supernatant after centrifugation and resuspend the cells in freezing medium at >5 × 10^6 cell/mL/vial.
Freeze the resuspended cells in a controlled-rate freezing container and store them in liquid nitrogen.
Seed PB MNCs at a density of 10^6 cells/cm^2 in an appropriate tissue culture plate.
Culture the seeded MNCs in the incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 2 days.
Collect the cultured cells after 2 days and transfer them into a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 220 × g for 5 min at 25°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellets in 1 mL MNC medium.
Count the viable cell number using a hemocytometer.
Seed the cells back to the tissue culture plate at a density of approximately 10^6 cells/cm².
Culture the cells in fresh MNC medium in the cell culture incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 2 days.
Repeat steps counting viable cell number and seeding every 2 days until the cell number significantly increases twice in succession.
After expansion, the expanded MNCs are ready for nucleofection.
Turn on Lonza 4D-Nucleofector System and select program “EO-100.”
Bring the Nucleofector solution and Supplement in P3 primary cell 4D-Nucleofector X Kit to 25°C.
Aliquot 2 × 106 cultured PB MNCs to a sterile 15 mL conical tube.
Add DPBS to a final volume of 5 mL and centrifuge the cells at 220 × g for 5 min at 25°C.
Remove supernatant completely and gently resuspend the MNC pellets in 100 μL transfection solution prepared previously.
Mix 82 μL Nucleofector Solution with 18 μL Supplement into a 0.6 mL microcentrifuge tube, mix thoroughly and keep at 25°C.
Add 4 μg EV SFFV-OS, 4 μg EV SFFV-MK, and 2 μg EV SFFV-BCL-XL into another 0.6 mL tube, mix thoroughly.
Mix the cell suspension with the plasmid DNA prepared previously.
Immediately transfer it to a sterile cuvette provided with the kit.
Place the cuvette with closed lid into the retainer of the 4D-Nucleofector X Unit and run the program.
Once nucleofection has been done, remove the cuvette.
Add 500 μL pre-warmed MNC medium.
Incubate in a cell culture incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 10 min.
Carefully aspirate the sample from the cuvette using a plastic pipette supplied with the kit.
Transfer and seed the cells into one well of a 12-well-plate with 1.5 mL pre-warmed MNC medium in it.
Culture in an incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 2 days.
Avoid repeated aspiration of nucleofected cells to protect them from mechanical damage.
Transfer recovered cells to a 15 mL sterile conical tube and centrifuge at 220 × g for 5 min at 25°C on Day 2.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 1 mL MEF medium.
Aliquot 10 μL cell suspension with 10 μL trypan blue and count viable cells using a hemocytometer.
Plate cells onto irradiated MEFs in Matrigel-coated 12-well-plate at a density of 2×10^5/well in MEF medium, and culture at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 1 day.
Collect the cells by aspiration and transfer to a sterile 15 mL conical tube on Day 3.
Centrifuge the tube at 220 × g for 5 min and resuspend the pellet with 3 mL KSR medium.
Seed the cells back to the wells and culture in an incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 5 days.
Half-refresh the KSR medium every other day.
Change the KSR medium to reprogramming medium on Day 8.
Refresh the medium every 2 days.
Check morphological changes of the cells under an inverted microscope daily.
Circle the location of NPC-like colonies on the bottom of the plate.
Dislodge an NPC-like colony under an inverted microscope using a 200 μL sterile pipette.
Break the dislodged colony into small clusters mechanically.
Plate the cells on a Matrigel-coated well in a 24-well-plate and incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for further expansion.
Discard the medium from culture plate when passaging iNPCs.
Add Accutase to culture plate at 1 mL/10 cm² surface area to detach cells.
Incubate the cells at 37°C for 4 minutes.
Dilute Accutase in N2B27 medium at a ratio of 1:5 and pipette cells several times to obtain single cell suspension.
Transfer cell suspension into a 15 mL sterile conical tube and centrifuge at 200 × g for 2 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend pellets in 1 mL of NPC medium#1.
Split the cells at a ratio of 1:3 and seed them onto Matrigel-coated dishes or plates.
Passage iNPCs every 3 days.
Change the culture medium to NPC medium#2 at passage 3 to acquire homogeneous morphology.
Discard the medium when cells fail to show homogeneous morphology.
Add Accutase at 1 mL per 10 cm² surface area and incubate at 37°C for 4 min.
Dilute the Accutase in N2B27 medium at a ratio of 1:5.
Pipette the cells several times into single cell suspension.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 15 mL sterile conical tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 2 min.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellets in 1 mL of NPC medium#2.
Seed all the cells onto an equal-sized petri-dish.
Culture the cells in 2 mL NPC medium#2 per 10 cm² surface area in an incubator at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 3 days to form neurospheres.
Collect the neurospheres and seed them directly onto Matrigel-coated tissue culture dishes at a ratio of 1:3.
Incubate the cells in NPC medium#2 in an incubator at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Dissociate the iNPCs with Accutase at 1 mL per 10 cm² surface area.
Centrifuge cells at 200 × g for 2 min after dissociation.
Resuspend pellets in 1 mL of ND medium.
Seed 2×10^5 cells on a PDL-Laminin coated 35 mm dish and culture in ND medium for neural differentiation.
Dissociate the cells using Accutase on differentiation day 7.
Reseed 2×10^5 cells on a PDL-Laminin coated 35 mm dish and culture in ND medium supplemented with 0.2 μM Compound E up to differentiation day 19.
Replace 80% of the old medium with fresh medium every 2 days during neural differentiation.
Fix cells for immunofluorescence staining at differentiation days 28-35.
